tasks.command:
Set-Location backend; @'
from sqlalchemy import text
from app.core.database import engine
from app.core.config import get_settings
schema = get_settings().database_schema
with engine.connect() as connection:
    rows = connection.execute(text("""
        select table_name, data_type, numeric_precision, numeric_scale
        from information_schema.columns
        where table_schema = :schema
          and (table_name, column_name) in (('productos', 'cantidad'), ('detalle_pedidos', 'cantidad'))
        order by table_name
    """), {'schema': schema}).all()
assert len(rows) == 2 and all(row.data_type == 'numeric' and row.numeric_scale == 2 for row in rows)
for row in rows:
    print(f'{row.table_name}.cantidad: numeric({row.numeric_precision},{row.numeric_scale})')
